prompt:
Create a cohesive 16-bit SNES/Sega-era RPG village in crisp pixel art, viewed from a top-down three-quarter perspective, with the warmth and richly detailed atmosphere of a classic Final Fantasy adventure translated into a consistent tiled world. Use a warm palette of honey-colored timber, cream plaster, terracotta roofs, mossy greens, golden paths, and clear turquoise water; use dark brown outlines, deliberate pixel clusters, restrained stepped shading, and no smooth gradients or antialiasing. Light every exterior, interior, object, and decoration from the upper left, casting shadows toward the lower right, and keep architecture, scale, tile proportions, and material colors consistent across the entire village. Include inviting houses, a dignified town hall, a small church, a general store, connected paths, trees, plants, flower beds, fountains, and handcrafted decorations, with generous open land for future expansion. Show no people, characters, creatures, lettering, signs with words, numbers, logos, or other text anywhere in the artwork.
ASSET EXCEPTION: The preceding guide supplies visual rendering only; its village composition and no-creatures rule are explicitly superseded for this requested character sprite asset. Generate a transparent-background 12-pose sprite sheet, exact 4 columns by 3 rows of equal cells, no text, no grid. SAME huge green Goblin King in every cell, full body with generous padding, facing RIGHT, same baseline and size. Scar across anatomical RIGHT eye, that eye closed; open left eye angry yellow, broken tusks, torn ear, battered iron crown, scarred bulky belly, rusty shoulder armor, tooth trophy belt, ragged dark red loincloth, knife handle protruding from thigh, enormous chipped spiked war cleaver. Menacing gruesome battle veteran without explicit gore. Pixel art matching detailed SNES fantasy game. Row-major poses: 0 ready standing, 1 running stride A, 2 running stride B, 3 roaring; 4 cleaver windup, 5 horizontal cleaver slash, 6 overhead cleaver slam, 7 brutal backhand; 8 crouched forward rush, 9 powerful extended chest-level kicking leg, 10 recoiling hurt, 11 fallen knockout. Each isolated complete figure fits its cell. No shadows outside cells. Crisp dark outlines, upper-left lighting, transparent background.
